Package com.egradx.audit.query

Record Class EgradxAuditRecord

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.egradx.audit.query.EgradxAuditRecord
Record Components:
seq - the order records were stored in — for a forwarder that must see each once
organizationName - resolved when read; null if unknown or when the record belongs to no organization
changedFields - the fields that differ between before and after, as dotted paths; null unless both were objects
public record EgradxAuditRecord(UUID id, long seq, Instant occurredAt, Instant recordedAt, UUID organizationId, String organizationName, String category, String action, EgradxAuditOutcome outcome, String reason, EgradxAuditRecord.Actor actor, EgradxAuditRecord.Entity entity, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode before, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode after, List<String> changedFields, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode details, String clientAddress, String userAgent, String requestId, String traceId) extends Record
One stored audit record, as read back.
